- `cadence` (`:178-187`) constructs ONE `Arc<MockProvider>` via `MockProvider::with_repeat(queue, repeat)` (`:179`), stores it once in `config.provider_override` via `make_config` (`:64-107`, field `:73`), and constructs ONE `context` via `fresh_session_context` (`:181`). - `send` (`:164-174`): `index == 0` → `agent_loop(vec![user("go")], context, config, tx, cancel)` (`:168`); else → `context.messages.push(user("again")); agent_loop_continue(context, config, tx, cancel)` (`:170-171`). With `sends=3` this is exactly 1 `agent_loop` + 2 `agent_loop_continue`.

### Claim 2 — Terminal-text-required contract (Tier D): a `[ToolCalls]`-only repeating provider is UNBOUNDED; a `max_turns`-bounded test asserts exactly N tool rounds in ONE send (proves §D6.4 — the kernel does NOT auto-terminate).

`tests/mock_repeat_test.rs:264-291` — `toolcalls_only_repeat_is_bounded_only_by_max_turns` constructs `MockProvider::repeating(vec![tool_calls()])` (`:266`, `[ToolCalls]`-only, repeat ON), sets `ExecutionLimits { max_turns: 4, ..Default::default() }` (`:267-270`), drives ONE `agent_loop` (`:275-282`), and asserts `tool_starts(&drain(rx)) == 4` (`:286-290`) with message "a [ToolCalls]-only repeat must loop until max_turns (unbounded without a terminal text)". The assertion of exactly `max_turns` (=4) tool rounds inside ONE send proves the loop is neither one-and-done (a terminal text would give 1) nor infinite — i.e., the kernel does not auto-synthesize a terminal text and does not auto-terminate under repeat.
